p: But aren’t her hands pledged to her husband, … who said: … when I become divorced.

But aren’t her hands pledged to her husband, to do the work she is obligated to perform for him? The Gemara answers: The mishna is referring to a woman who said: The vow will take effect when I become divorced.
She is not divorced now in any event,
